_doc: NPC_AI_SPEC §3.2 / §12 — drive decay rates, per need, per need-profile.
Every need is a SATISFACTION level in 0..1: 1 = fully satisfied, 0 = desperate.
They all decay DOWNWARD, so a consideration reads urgency as (1 - need).
bladder 1 = empty, 0 = bursting. energy 1 = rested. hygiene 1 = clean.
decayPerSec is in GAME seconds (agentManager.now), and a full day is
worldEnv.dayLength = 720s — so 0.0014/s empties a need in about one day.
start is the value a freshly spawned agent begins at.
